mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where every twist and turn in self-publishing feels a bit like steering a tiny boat through a wild, unpredictable storm. You know, it’s one of those adventures where every wave can bring a fresh challenge—or maybe even a hidden opportunity. If you’ve ever wondered what it really takes to thrive as an indie author, you’re in the right place. Because together, we’re about to explore how resilience, adaptability, and a healthy dose of creativity become your lifelines in this ever-shifting landscape. In his book, Self-Publishing In the Eye of the Storm, Karl Wiggins invites us into a world where the old publishing rules just don’t matter as much anymore. The gatekeepers have lost their grip, and suddenly, writers like you and me get to decide our own path. Technology is changing by the minute, readers are looking for something new, and the market? Well, it’s as unpredictable as ever. But here’s the exciting part—this is where innovation and resourcefulness become your superpowers. As we explore this world together, you’ll see that self-publishing isn’t just about putting a book out there. It’s about learning the balancing act between creating, promoting, and pushing forward even when things get tough. You’ll discover what it means to build your audience from scratch, deal with setbacks, and—most importantly—celebrate those small victories that remind you why you started in the first place. So, let’s step into the eye of the storm, where things might be wild all around us—but together, we’ll find that sense of calm, clarity, and purpose that keeps every independent author moving ahead.
